reason: PURE. The first thing I checked was whether 200 mg was really two capsules, and the box says it plainly (100 mg per capsule, 2 in each sachet), so no trick there. What I noticed next was the 'Every batch lab-tested' line with the QR code, and I would scan it before ordering. For sleep I want bisglycinate with no oxide, and $1 a serving is fair for that.
objection: No reviews at all. I would be trusting a brand nobody has tried yet with something I take every night, and I would not put it on auto-ship until I had finished one box and the batch report held up.
would_change_my_mind: A real batch report behind the QR that matches the label, plus a handful of honest reviews. If the report would not open or showed a different magnesium amount, I would pass.
